label: Si triplexer of three cascaded asymmetrical directional couplers (1310 / 1490 / 1550 nm), 220 nm SOI, ~150 um long
core_material: Si 220 nm, fully etched (single EBL step + ICP-RIE), on 2 um buried oxide
notes: Three cascaded ADC filters, each two single-mode waveguides with a multimode waveguide between them (TE0 to TE1 phase matching); ADC1 / ADC2 / ADC3 phase-matched at 1.49 / 1.55 / 1.31 um; outputs O1 1.49 um, O2 1.55 um, O3 1.31 um (Fig. 3, Fig. 5). Each multimode waveguide ends in a 3 um taper that radiates the remaining TE1 mode. TE only (birefringence, p.4). Measured with focused grating couplers, two copies of the triplexer with 1.31 um and 1.52 um gratings, normalized to straight waveguides with the same gratings (p.3); supercontinuum source + OSA. Abstract 'less than 1 dB for all the three channels' is the summary of the per-channel rows. Simulated 3D-FDTD values on this row are basis simulated (D80e). Fab empty: passive fabrication sentences only (p.3, D80b); both authors at Zhejiang University; no facility named. Grating couplers (focused, design cited ref. [10]): the 1.31 um copy uses gratings centred at 1.31 um (bandwidth about 80 nm), the 1.49 / 1.55 um copy gratings centred at 1.52 um (bandwidth about 100 nm); bandwidth definition not stated, no coupling efficiency printed (p.3); no grating-coupler rows (stated working wavelengths only).

label: Silica PLC 8x8 strictly nonblocking thermo-optic matrix switch, double-MZI units, PI-loss arrangement, 68 x 68 mm
core_material: GeO2-SiO2 core 7 x 7 um, relative index difference 0.75 %, FHD + RIE on a Si wafer (4-in)
cladding: SiO2 (FHD) cladding; Cr thin-film heaters and Au wiring on the over-cladding
notes: Eight switching-unit stages of eight double-MZI units each (path-independent-loss arrangement, intersections placed beside the units, Fig. 3 / Fig. 4); 15 intersections, 2 ON-MZIs and 7 OFF-MZIs per path (Table I). Total waveguide length 290 mm (Table I; not entered: no parameter for a path length). Minimum bend radius 5 mm and intersection angle about 30 deg (p.3): no switch_fabric parameter (registry gap, D596). A light absorber in a groove between input and output ports removes leaked light; it improved the average / worst extinction ratio by 2.5 / 0.4 dB (p.4); whether the 64-path data include it is not stated explicitly. Setup at 1.55 um: depolarized FP laser diode, PM fiber butted at the input and 1.3 um zero-dispersion SMF at the output (p.3). Conventional single-MZI crossbar values in Tables I-II are the authors' earlier switch (not entered). Thermal crosstalk (Fig. 9): ON-state transmittance variation 0.04 dB and OFF-state variation up to 4 dB for a 64 dB unit (no parameter). Average loss degradation 0.1 dB with different-wavelength optimization (p.6). Fab org_ntt: first-person fabrication sentence (p.3 'We fabricated this ... switch on a silicon wafer'), all authors at NTT Photonics Laboratories / NTT Network Innovation Laboratories (D154 parent, D72); staff also thanked for PLC fabrication help (p.6).
